ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly high-intensity (white) across approximately 85% of the visible surface area, with low-intensity (black) concentrated at the margins and median notch.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white regions occupy the central and inner areas of both lobes. A continuous band of black pigmentation follows the trailing edge. A distinct vertical black column originates at the median notch, tapering as it descends toward the water line. Sparse, isolated black pixel clusters (mottling) are distributed across the interior white fields.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a calculated interior angle of approximately 42 degrees; the vertex is sharply defined by the convergence of the lobe margins.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, moderate-amplitude serrations present along the entire continuous trailing edge boundary, manifesting as a jagged interface between the black pigmentation and the water/sky background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The trailing edge follows an outward convex curve from the median notch to the distal tips, with the left lobe exhibiting a slightly more acute upward sweep than the right.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast, roughly circular pixel clusters indicative of barnacle colonization are localized at the extreme distal tips of both lobes, creating a white-on-black textured pattern.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Detection of several distinct, low-intensity linear disruptions; specifically, one diagonal rake mark on the left lobe and multiple faint vertical streaks on the right lobe that break the white pigment uniformity.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant clusters of barnacles (Cirripedia) attached to the posterior corners of both lobes, altering the geometric profile of the tips.
other_distinctive_markers: Strongly defined, nearly symmetrical white 'wings' with minimal central mottling, partitioned by a sharp black vertical axis at the notch.
